Package hkust.marketplace.model

Class ChatMessage

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.model.ChatMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ChatMessage extends Object implements Serializable
One message in a chat thread. A formal offer is a message linked to a deal.
